workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: A full-window layout for one task that needs room. The top bar, side panels and work area scroll on their own. See four examples with code.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: A short status label with a light fill and dark text, for tables, card headers and page titles. Tones, sizes, icons and dots, with HTML for each.

item.title: Item
item.description: One row made of a figure (icon, image or avatar), a section with title and description, and an aside for buttons or trailing info. Examples and markup.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: A breadcrumb trail that shows where the current page sits in the site, with links back up each level. Separators, truncation and the markup to copy.

date-picker.title: Date picker
date-picker.description: A field or button that opens a calendar. Choose one date or a range, type a date, or take a preset. Built on Vanilla Calendar Pro with Tsunami styling.

code-editor.title: Code editor
code-editor.description: A code editor on a plain textarea, powered by Monaco and loaded by the page, with Tsunami colours and fonts. Languages, themes, read-only mode and options.

save-bar.title: Save bar
save-bar.description: A sticky bottom bar that appears when a form is edited and hides again when the values match the saved ones. Try editing the forms in the live examples.

page-header.title: Page header
page-header.description: The top of a page: a breadcrumb, a back button, the page title and actions on the right. Variants with badges, tabs and subtitles, with copyable HTML.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: One line of text on hover or keyboard focus, set from a single attribute. No script needed. Placement, delay and how to use tooltips accessibly.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: A rich text editor on a textarea, powered by TinyMCE and loaded by the page, with a quiet toolbar that follows the Tsunami theme. Setup, options and examples.

button.title: Button
button.description: Buttons are outline by default; use primary only for the main action on a page. Variants, sizes, icon buttons, button groups, pressed and disabled states.

loader.title: Loader
loader.description: A spinner for waiting states that takes the colour of the surrounding text, so it fits inside buttons and text. Sizes, usage and a link to Skeleton.

empty-state.title: Empty state
empty-state.description: An empty state for when there is no data yet: an icon, a title, a description, starting actions and a learn-more link. Layouts for pages, cards and tables.

journey.title: Journey
journey.description: Shows the path sessions take, step by step. Pick a page in each step and a line links it to the next step. Markup and data attributes for the journey view.

drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.description: A native dialog element that slides in from an edge of the window, opened and closed with commandfor and command attributes. Sides, sizes and examples.

image-field.title: Image field
image-field.description: An image input with change and clear buttons; the form sends the file. Preview shapes, sizes, empty and filled states, with the markup for each.

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Softly pulsing grey blocks that stand in for loading content. Match the shape of the real content so the page does not jump when data arrives.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Move between pages of a long list with previous and next links and page numbers. Compact and full forms, current page and disabled states, with HTML.

color-field.title: Color field
color-field.description: A colour picker beside a text field. The text field holds the colour value and is what the form sends. Swatches, presets, disabled state and markup.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: A layout helper that spaces out its child elements, vertical by default. Horizontal direction, gaps, alignment and wrapping, with live examples and HTML.

subnav.title: Subnav
subnav.description: Section links beside the content, for moving between related pages such as settings sections. Active state, groups, icons and the markup to copy.

command.title: Command
command.description: A command menu: a search field over a list of items, with groups, filters and keyboard control. Use it stand-alone or inside a dialog as a palette.

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: An inline message with an icon, title, body and actions. Neutral by default, with status variants in a light fill with dark text. Examples and markup.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: A native modal dialog element, opened and closed by buttons with the commandfor and command attributes. No script needed. Sizes, forms and confirm dialogs.

accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.description: Collapsible items built on the browser's details element, with no JavaScript needed. Single and multiple open items, icons, nesting and the markup to copy.

theme-switcher.title: Theme switcher
theme-switcher.description: The theme lives in data-theme on the html element. Theme buttons remember the choice in localStorage and set aria-pressed for you. Light, dark and system.

card.title: Card
card.description: A box with a 1px border where each direct child (header, section, table, footer) is a part, separated by a line. Examples with forms, tables and actions.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Icons from the Lucide icon font, sized by data-size or the font size and coloured like the surrounding text. Search the full icon set and copy the class.

input.title: Input
input.description: Text, file and textarea inputs. Use the input class on its own, or put the input in a field with no class. Sizes, states, validation and markup to copy.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Switch between panels in one place. Arrow keys, Home and End select a tab. Underline and pill styles, icons, badges and accessible markup to copy.

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: Nested folders and files built on details elements, so no JavaScript is needed. Icons, selected state and deep nesting, with the HTML for a file tree.

popover.title: Popover
popover.description: A native popover opened by its button with popovertarget and placed beside it with CSS anchor positioning. No script needed. Placement and examples.

link.title: Link
link.description: Links in text and data: a bare a is the accent colour, while the link class takes the text colour. Hover, visited, external and disabled links with HTML.

chart.title: Chart
chart.description: Line, bar, doughnut and other charts drawn on a canvas by Chart.js, in the colours and type of the rest of the page. Setup, options and live examples.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: App navigation on the left that collapses to icons. Groups, headings, badges, active items and the markup for a back-office sidebar, with live examples.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: One typeface, Google Sans, for both Thai and Latin, at a 14px base size and 1.55 line height. The typography class adds spacing, lists and quotes to content.

sortable.title: Sortable
sortable.description: Drag the rows of a list, table or grid into a new order, or move them with the arrow keys. A thin layer over SortableJS with Tsunami styling.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: A vertical list of events for an order or a job, built with ol and time elements. Status markers, icons, timestamps and comments, with copyable HTML.

stat.title: Stat
stat.description: A single figure with a label, a value and a change indicator. Use it alone, in a card, or in a row with stat-group. Trends, icons and examples.

table.title: Table
table.description: A quiet table with small grey headers, row dividers and tabular numbers. Sort, select, filter, page and hide columns with table.js. Examples and markup.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: A photo, logo or initials in a rounded frame. Sizes, shapes, fallback initials, status dots and avatar groups, with the HTML for each variant.

input-group.title: Input group
input-group.description: One box holding an input with text or icons at the start and end, styled like the plain input. Prefixes, suffixes, buttons and the markup to copy.

dropdown.title: Dropdown
dropdown.description: A menu of actions in a native popover, opened by its button with no script. Items, icons, groups, dividers and destructive actions, with HTML.

dropzone.title: Dropzone
dropzone.description: A box that takes files dropped on it or chosen with a click, and the form sends the files. File list, limits, states and the markup to copy.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Country flags at a 4:3 ratio from flag-icons, one class per flag. Search the full set, see sizes and copy the class name for any country.

json-viewer.title: JSON viewer
json-viewer.description: A foldable tree drawn from a textarea that holds the JSON. Without the script the textarea is all there is. Options, depth and examples.

workspace-full.title: Workspace example
workspace-full.description: A full-page example of the Tsunami workspace layout with no docs chrome: a store settings screen with a top bar, side panels and a scrolling work area.

index.title: Overview
index.description: Tsunami is a quiet UI framework: semantic HTML, data attributes and a little vanilla JS, 65 components, and a core with no dependencies.

field.title: Field
field.description: Labels, inputs and hints, plus checkbox, radio, switch and slider rows. Layouts, required marks, error and disabled states, with the HTML for each.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: A short message after an action, such as a save or a delete. It stacks in a corner, shows above dialogs in the top layer and closes on its own.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: A text input with suggestions. The value is free text: any typed text is kept and a suggestion only saves typing. Data sources, filtering and markup.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: The Tsunami colours are CSS variables that change value with the theme, and components only use these variables. Palette, tones and light and dark values.

select.title: Select
select.description: Pick from a list with a native select, or one with a styled list; the real select still submits the value. Search, groups and multiple choice, with HTML.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: A progress bar made of one track with one span per part, where a span's width is its share. Sizes, tones, labels and multi-part bars, with markup.

scroll-area.title: Scroll area
scroll-area.description: A scrolling region inside a fixed-height box with a thin scrollbar. Vertical, horizontal and both directions, with the markup and CSS to copy.

otp.title: One-time code
otp.description: A row of single-character boxes for a verification code. Moves on as you type, spreads a paste or an SMS autofill, and sends one joined value with the form.

bulk-bar.title: Bulk action bar
bulk-bar.description: A sticky bar that shows how many table rows are selected and offers actions and a clear button.

description-list.title: Description list
description-list.description: A semantic dl for label and value pairs on detail pages, in stacked, inline and grid layouts.

segmented.title: Segmented control
segmented.description: A compact group of two to four exclusive options built on native radio inputs, lighter than tabs and working in forms without JavaScript.

status-dot.title: Status dot
status-dot.description: A small coloured dot with an optional label for online, health and sync status, with an optional pulse for live states.

copy-button.title: Copy button
copy-button.description: A button that copies text to the clipboard from an attribute or another element and shows a check for a moment.

filter-bar.title: Filter bar and chips
filter-bar.description: A chip is a small pill with a remove button; a filter bar is a wrapping row of chips with a Clear all button that tells the page when a filter is removed.

tag-input.title: Tag input
tag-input.description: An input that holds tags: Enter or comma adds one, Backspace removes the last, a paste is split, and a form gets one comma-separated value.

stepper.title: Stepper
stepper.description: A multi-step form wizard with a step header, one panel at a time, Next and Back buttons, optional validation before each step and events for step changes.

phone-input.title: Phone input
phone-input.description: A phone number field with a searchable country button (flag and dial code) that sends the full international number; it formats and joins, it does not validate.

time-picker.title: Time picker
time-picker.description: A time field with separate hour, minute, second and AM or PM segments you type into or step with the arrow keys, sending HH:MM in a form.

javascript.title: JavaScript
javascript.description: How to call the tsunami object, listen for tsunami: events, wait for library components, and read the API section of a component page, with a table of every module.

container.title: Container
container.description: Centres a page's content and limits its width, in four sizes, so a form or a dashboard does not stretch across a wide screen.
